file.content:
- AC3's dynamic count comes free from basket cache invalidation.
- AC8: verify the scroll-lock **restores** position on close rather than merely unlocking.
- **315 owns the empty-state *header text* only.** The empty *body* is SFCC-277's. Clean split.
- 315 is a dependency for SFCC-270, 274, 316, 318, 404 — and **SFCC-316 (Zimmermann Benefits –
  Contentful) is Sprint 5, Ready for Development, assigned to Jhoan Rose Dela Cruz.** Someone else's
  active-sprint card is waiting on this. **Ship 315 first and standalone.**

### SFCC-270 — Cart Item UI Part 1 · 9 ACs · all buildable

ACs: per line item — image; name to the right of the image; price; selected colour; selected size;
quantity with `+`/`–` either side; multiple items each individually identifiable; Remove and Wishlist
as **underlined text links below the stepper**; on mobile nothing truncated or hidden.

**DECIDED (Marcel, 2026-09-16): override base `product-item`.** Cart keeps using it. Separately,
upcoming wishlist work moves the account wishlist page onto `ZimmProductCard` (which already has a
`variation: 'wishlist'` with `showRemove`), so it stops consuming `product-item` at that point.

Accurate consumer map — **two chains only**:
```
pages/cart  ->  components/product-item-list  ->  components/product-item
pages/account/wishlist  ->  components/product-item          (direct)
```
Checkout does **not** use it. The base has two separate line-item systems: `product-item` (the full
interactive row) and `item-variant/*` (a read-only composition used by `order-summary`, i.e. the
checkout summaries).

**Copy-first scope — 3 files** from `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-item/`:
`index.jsx` (7.4 KB), `bonus-product-quantity.jsx` (1.5 KB), `product-quantity-picker.jsx` (3.4 KB),
each to `.tsx`. Base's own `.test.js`/`.test.jsx` are not copied — write our own.

**The finding that changes the size of the job:** `product-item/index.jsx` renders its visible content
through **five more base components** — `components/item-variant` plus `item-variant/item-image`,
`item-name`, `item-attributes`, `item-price`. So overriding `product-item` gives you the row's
*structure and controls*; the *content pieces* still come from `item-variant/*`. Styling those to
Figma means either overriding `item-variant/*` too — which also changes `order-summary`, and
therefore the checkout summaries — or not using them inside our override and composing the content
ourselves. **Decide this before starting: it is the difference between a 3-file override and an
8-file one with checkout blast radius.**

**`shared/ui` barrel trap applies.** `product-item/index.jsx` imports from `components/shared/ui`.
Per the known trap, overriding an individual `shared/ui/<Name>` intercepts nothing — 208 base files
import the barrel, so only overriding the barrel itself has any effect.

**Bridge-pattern requirement:** because `product-item` is used internally by base components, the
override's **default export must stay API-compatible** (full original prop surface) so
`product-item-list` and the wishlist page keep working. Per `overrideStyling.md`, put brand styling
in a **theme recipe**, not a named-export split — token-driven theming doesn't need the second
export that `CardBaseline`'s prop-narrowing did.

**DECIDED (Marcel, 2026-09-16): Option B — override `item-variant/*` as well. 8 files.**
`product-item/{index,bonus-product-quantity,product-quantity-picker}` +
`item-variant/{index,item-image,item-name,item-attributes,item-price}`, all to `.tsx`.

Verified before deciding: **every consumer of `item-variant/*` is base/OOTB with no Zimmermann
design or development**, so brand styling landing on them is an upgrade toward Zimmermann, not a
regression from it. Full consumer list — `components/order-summary` (no override),
`components/multiship/multiship-order-summary`, `pages/account/order-detail` (account has zero
overrides), `pages/account/wishlist/partials/wishlist-primary-action` +
`wishlist-secondary-button-group` (and wishlist is migrating to `ZimmProductCard` anyway),
`pages/cart/partials/cart-secondary-button-group` (base cart page, replaced by the drawer),
`pages/checkout/partials/{pickup-address,product-shipping-address-card,shipping-product-cards}`
(checkout override is only `payment.tsx`), `pages/checkout-one-click/partials/one-click-product-shipping-address-card`.

**`pages/confirmation` is NOT in the blast radius** — `overrides/app/pages/confirmation/index.tsx`
already exists and does not use `item-variant`, so the base confirmation page is shadowed and never
renders. That was the one surface worth worrying about (a shopper sees it after paying).

**Two requirements for the override, both load-bearing:**
1. **Keep the defaults-then-spread order.** Callers set their own geometry —
   `order-summary` does `<CartItemVariantImage width="80px" mr={2} />` — and must keep winning.
   Write `<Box width={zimmDefault} {...props}>`, never the reverse, or you break layouts that work
   today. `item-image`, `item-attributes` and `item-price` already have it right.
2. **Fix `item-name` while in there.** Base is `<Link {...props} color="black.600">` — spread
   *before* the colour, so no caller can ever override it. Move the spread after; no base caller
   passes `color`, so nothing changes for them.

**Deferred consequence, accepted:** when checkout is designed it will inherit cart-derived
line-item styling it never specified. Whoever picks up checkout should know why it already looks
part-branded.

**Governance:** `overrides/app/components/product-item/` is **Tier 2, Squad B-owned (notify Squad A)**
per `protectedFiles.md`. CODEOWNERS will request Squad B's review on a Squad A ticket.

**Interim consequence, low risk:** while the account wishlist page still consumes `product-item`, our
override's styling reaches it too. `overrides/app/pages/` contains no account pages at all — account
is entirely base and unstyled today — so the exposure is minimal until the wishlist migration lands.

### SFCC-271 — Quantity Stepper · 4 ACs · all buildable

ACs: `+` increments by 1 with item total and order summary updating; `–` decrements when quantity > 1;
at quantity 1 the `–` is disabled and quantity stays 1; drawer count (`Bag 3`) and order summary both
update without a full page load.

- **No SFCC-274 dependency** — see §2.8. Deliverable is the mutation call, the debounce, the
  optimistic local quantity, and the error rollback. The summary updating falls out of invalidation.
- Courtesy heads-up to Hazel (SFCC-274's assignee): the stepper lands first and sets the
  invalidation contract; the order summary should read basket state via `useCurrentBasket()` rather
  than holding its own copy.

### SFCC-795 — Cart Item UI Part 2 · the largest card

Groups: default state (restates 270); stepper states (quantity 1 → `–` disabled/greyed; > 1 → both
enabled; at max → `+` disabled/greyed; fully OOS or unavailable → **both** disabled/greyed); error
state (red inline message beneath the stepper — OOS, Partially OOS, Unavailable, copy supplied);
promotional price ("Was $X" / "Now $Y" replacing standard price, plus a discount label beneath the
stepper e.g. "20% off applied"); warning state (grey info icon + message, e.g. "Maximum purchase
quantity reached for this size"); responsive; and **11 accessibility ACs**.

Decisions:
- **Overlap with 270/271/250 is intentional layering — build once, satisfy all.** This is the
  explicit reason for bundling. Consequence to accept: the ACs can't be signed off independently and
  Zephyr will count the same coverage from three keys.
- **Error states: presentation here, triggering logic elsewhere.** OOS / Partially OOS belong to
  SFCC-282, Unavailable to SFCC-796 — both Sprint 6, Tech design, Hazel's. Build the states
  prop-driven with stories; not provable end to end this sprint.
- **Promotional price: the was/now mechanism already exists.** Base `display-price` takes `priceData`
  with `listPrice`/`currentPrice`/`isOnSale`, renders `ListPrice` for the struck value, and already
  multiplies by quantity (`price={listPrice * quantity}`) so it is line-item aware. `cart.md` CAI-013
  confirms sale was/now is in scope and price-book sourced. **Only the discount label is new, and it
  is purely presentational** — prop-driven, storied, wired when the promotions engine lands.
  Note `display-price` has no override and is a shared SFCC internal; if Zimmermann styling is needed,
  use the bridge pattern (faithful default export, styling in a recipe).
- **The 44×44px touch-target AC: annotate, do not escalate.** `ZimmButton`'s `icon` size is 24px,
  deliberately WCAG 2.2 AA SC 2.5.8 (§2.11). The card asks for 44×44 while labelling it "WCAG 2.1 AA"
  — 44×44 is 2.1 **AAA**, and `AGENTS.md`'s standard is 2.2 AA. **Decision: inherit the existing 24px**,
  add an inline comment naming 795's AC and the mislabelling per the house pattern in §2.15, and add
  it to the UI designer's open list alongside the hover contrast (2.96:1) and inverse focus ring
  already there. Growing the atom would hit every icon button in the app.

### SFCC-272 — Remove and Wishlist Actions · 8 ACs · 8 of 8 deliverable

ACs — Remove (3): item removed with drawer count decrementing and totals updating; removing the last
item shows the empty state "as per SFCC-277"; quantity > 1 removes all units in one action.
Wishlist (5): authenticated qty 1 → moved, removed from cart, count decrements, totals update,
**page-level success banner** "[Product Name] has been moved to your wishlist"; authenticated qty > 1

 * (retail-react-app 10.0.0), converted to TypeScript per AGENTS.md's copy-first rule (SFCC-270,

 * rewrites documented below, and the temporary `[overrides]` console.log marker are the only
 * changes; styling/behaviour changes are a later commit (2.2), not this one.
 *
 * Import path rewrites, per .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md's "Importing an already-overridden
 * component from a new component":
 * - `item-variant` / `item-variant/item-image` / `item-variant/item-name` /

 *   unstyled base components in Storybook/Vitest instead of these overrides.
 * - `./bonus-product-quantity` / `./product-quantity-picker`: same reasoning, both overridden in
 *   this same commit, in this same folder.
 * - `responsive` (`HideOnDesktop`/`HideOnMobile`): also already overridden in this repo

 *   behavioural difference (it moves the mobile/desktop split to Chakra's `md` breakpoint instead

 * usage — this package ships no TypeScript types for this shape, matching the same documented gap
 * at overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx:136-151.

import React from 'react'

// Chakra Components
import {Box, Fade, Flex, Stack, Text} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

// Project Components
import {HideOnDesktop, HideOnMobile} from '../responsive'
import ItemVariantProvider from '../item-variant'
import CartItemVariantImage from '../item-variant/item-image'
import CartItemVariantName from '../item-variant/item-name'
import CartItemVariantAttributes from '../item-variant/item-attributes'
import CartItemVariantPrice from '../item-variant/item-price'
import LoadingSpinner from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/loading-spinner'
import BonusProductQuantity from './bonus-product-quantity'
import ProductQuantityPicker from './product-quantity-picker'

// Utilities
import {noop} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/utils'

// Hooks
import {useCurrency, useDerivedProduct} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks'

type SfccProduct = any

type ProductItemProps = {
    product: SfccProduct
    primaryAction?: React.ReactNode
    secondaryActions?: React.ReactNode
    deliveryActions?: React.ReactNode

     * Declared on the base file's propTypes but never read inside this component's own render

    isWishlistItem?: boolean
    containerStyles?: Record<string, any>
    isRemoving?: boolean
    pickupInStore?: boolean
}

/**
 * Component representing a product item usually in a list with details about the product - name, variant, pricing, etc.
 * @param {Object} product Product to be represented in the list item.
 * @param {node} primaryAction Child component representing the most prominent action to be performed by the user.
 * @param {node} secondaryActions Child component representing the other actions relevant to the product to be performed by the user.
 * @param {node} deliveryActions Child component representing the delivery actions relevant to the product to be performed by the user.
 * @param {func} onItemQuantityChange callback function to be invoked whenever item quantity changes.
 * @param {boolean} showLoading Renders a loading spinner with overlay if set to true.
 * @returns A JSX element representing product item in a list (eg: wishlist, cart, etc).

    product,
    primaryAction,
    secondaryActions,
    deliveryActions,
    onItemQuantityChange = noop,
    showLoading = false,
    containerStyles = {},
    isRemoving = false,
    pickupInStore = false
}: ProductItemProps) => {

    const {stepQuantity, showInventoryMessage, inventoryMessage, quantity, setQuantity} =
        useDerivedProduct(product, false, false, pickupInStore)
    const {currency: activeCurrency} = useCurrency()
    return (
        <Box
            position="relative"
            data-testid={`sf-cart-item-${product.productId ? product.productId : product.id}`}
        >
            <ItemVariantProvider variant={product}>
                {showLoading && <LoadingSpinner />}
                <Stack layerStyle="cardBordered" align="flex-start" {...containerStyles}>
                    <Flex width="full" alignItems="flex-start" backgroundColor="white">
                        <CartItemVariantImage width={['88px', '136px']} mr={4} />
                        <Stack spacing={3} flex={1}>
                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    <CartItemVariantName />
                                    <CartItemVariantAttributes excludeBonusLabel />
                                    <HideOnDesktop>
                                        <Box marginTop={2}>
                                            <CartItemVariantPrice
                                                align="left"
                                                currency={activeCurrency}
                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                    </HideOnDesktop>
                                </Stack>
                                {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                    <HideOnMobile>{deliveryActions}</HideOnMobile>
                                )}
                            </Flex>

                            {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                <HideOnDesktop>{deliveryActions}</HideOnDesktop>
                            )}

                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    {!(isRemoving && product.bonusProductLineItem) &&
                                        (product.bonusProductLineItem ? (
                                            <BonusProductQuantity product={product} />
                                        ) : (
                                            <ProductQuantityPicker
                                                product={product}
                                                onItemQuantityChange={onItemQuantityChange}
                                                stepQuantity={stepQuantity}
                                                quantity={quantity}
                                                setQuantity={setQuantity}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                </Stack>
                                <Stack>
                                    <HideOnMobile>
                                        <CartItemVariantPrice currency={activeCurrency} />
                                    </HideOnMobile>
                                    <Box display={['none', 'block', 'block', 'block']}>
                                        {primaryAction}
                                    </Box>
                                </Stack>
                            </Flex>

                            <Box>
                                {product && showInventoryMessage && (
                                    <Fade in={true}>
                                        <Text color="orange.600" fontWeight={600}>
                                            {inventoryMessage}
                                        </Text>
                                    </Fade>
                                )}
                            </Box>

                            {secondaryActions}
                        </Stack>
                    </Flex>

                    <Box display={['block', 'none', 'none', 'none']} w={'full'}>
                        {primaryAction}
                    </Box>
                </Stack>
            </ItemVariantProvider>
        </Box>
    )
}

export default ProductItem

                                </Stack>
                                {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                    <HideOnMobile>{deliveryActions}</HideOnMobile>
                                )}
                            </Flex>

                            {deliveryActions && !product.bonusProductLineItem && (
                                <HideOnDesktop>{deliveryActions}</HideOnDesktop>
                            )}

                            <Flex align="flex-end" justify="space-between">
                                <Stack spacing={1}>
                                    {!(isRemoving && product.bonusProductLineItem) &&
                                        (product.bonusProductLineItem ? (
                                            <BonusProductQuantity product={product} />
                                        ) : (
                                            <ProductQuantityPicker
                                                product={product}
                                                onItemQuantityChange={onItemQuantityChange}
                                                stepQuantity={stepQuantity}
                                                quantity={quantity}
                                                setQuantity={setQuantity}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                </Stack>
                                <Stack>
                                    <HideOnMobile>
                                        <CartItemVariantPrice currency={activeCurrency} />
                                    </HideOnMobile>
                                    <Box display={['none', 'block', 'block', 'block']}>
                                        {primaryAction}
                                    </Box>
                                </Stack>
                            </Flex>

                            <Box>
                                {product && showInventoryMessage && (
                                    <Fade in={true}>
                                        <Text color="orange.600" fontWeight={600}>
                                            {inventoryMessage}
                                        </Text>
                                    </Fade>
                                )}
                            </Box>

                            {secondaryActions}
                        </Stack>
                    </Flex>

                    <Box display={['block', 'none', 'none', 'none']} w={'full'}>
                        {primaryAction}
                    </Box>
                </Stack>
            </ItemVariantProvider>
        </Box>
    )
}

ProductItem.propTypes = {
    product: PropTypes.object,
    onItemQuantityChange: PropTypes.func,
    onAddItemToCart: PropTypes.func,
    showLoading: PropTypes.bool,
    isWishlistItem: PropTypes.bool,
    primaryAction: PropTypes.node,
    secondaryActions: PropTypes.node,
    deliveryActions: PropTypes.node,
    containerStyles: PropTypes.object,
    isRemoving: PropTypes.bool,
    pickupInStore: PropTypes.bool
}

export default ProductItem

import React from 'react'
import {useItemVariant} from '.'
import Link from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/link'
import {Heading} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'

/**
 * In the context of a cart product item variant, this components simply renders
 * the item's name using the cart item field `productName`. We use this field
 * rather than variant `name` field as the variant detail may not yet be
 * available upon rendering.
 */
const ItemName = (props: Record<string, any>) => {
    console.log('[overrides] item-name.tsx')
    const variant = useItemVariant()
    const productId = variant?.master?.masterId || variant.id

    return (
        <Heading as="h2" fontSize="md">
            <Link {...props} color="black.600" to={`/product/${productId}`}>
                {variant.productName || variant.name}
            </Link>
        </Heading>
    )
}

export default ItemName

19	import React from 'react'
20	import {AspectRatio, Box, Badge, Image} from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui'
21	import {useItemVariant} from '.'
22	import {FormattedMessage} from 'react-intl'

25	// See index.tsx's own note on why this is `any` rather than a structural type.

29	    imageProps?: Record<string, any>

33	/**
34	 * In the context of a cart product item variant, this component renders the item's
35	 * main image.
36	 *
37	 * @todo = This component will render a `SALE` badge when the qualifier is available
38	 * on the custom property `c_isSale`. This will need to be expanded upon to handle
39	 * different badge/qualifiers and property names.
40	 */

42	    console.log('[overrides] item-image.tsx')

44

62	                            fontSize="10px"
63	                            variant="solid"
64	                            colorScheme="blue"
65	                        >
66	                            <FormattedMessage
67	                                defaultMessage="Sale"

74	                        <Badge
75	                            position="absolute"
76	                            top={0}
77	                            left={0}
78	                            marginLeft={2}
79	                            marginTop={2}
80	                            fontSize="10px"
81	                            variant="solid"
82	                            colorScheme="red"
83	                        >
84	                            <FormattedMessage

86	                                id="item_image.label.unavailable"
87	                                description="A unavailable badge placed on top of a product image"
88	                            />
89	                        </Badge>

98	                        />

104	}
